{{Top|leg}}
The '''HP-S-5 starfighter armor''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] developed by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. HP-S-5 starfighter armor layered additional [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and various patented alloys onto a ship's hull, allowing it to sustain more damage.
